title: Recent advances in first-row transition metal clusters for photocatalytic water splitting
claim: The active species in reported cobalt-cubane water-oxidation systems cannot uniformly be assigned to the intact molecular cubane.
explanation: The review describes a proposal that Co(II) impurities in some Co(III)-cubane preparations form active heterogeneous cobalt oxide, alongside a Co(II)-cubane example for which prior oxidation of all Co(II) centers to Co(III) was not required.
scope: Photocatalytic water oxidation using molecular Co4O4 cubanes.
caveats: These observations concern different systems and do not resolve the mechanism for every cobalt cubane.
